title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How Ronnie Care Foundation protects and manages your information.
body:
### 1. Information We Collect

Ronnie Care Foundation is committed to protecting your privacy. We collect information you provide directly through our donation portal, newsletter forms, and partnership intake.

### 2. How We Use Information

Your data is used solely to process contributions, provide program updates, and coordinate community outreach programs in Abuja and surrounding regions.

### 3. Data Protection & Security

We implement industry-standard 256-bit SSL encryption to ensure your personal and payment information remains secure.

### 4. Contact Us

For privacy inquiries or data requests, contact us at contact@ronniecare.org.
